title: Separable ground-field extension exchange
statement: Let L/K be a possibly transcendental separable extension, meaning every finitely generated intermediate field is separably generated. Let g:T to S be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of K-schemes. For every bounded below derived abelian etale complex E on T whose geometric cohomology stalk elements have positive annihilators nonzero in K, the canonical exchange for T_L to S_L over T to S is invertible.

source.place: Tag 0F1C, lemma-base-change-field-extension, separable case; Tag 0F09, lemma-smooth-base-change-general

proof.text: Use the full ordered collection A of finitely generated smooth K-subalgebras of L. The smooth-subalgebra theorem makes A nonempty and directed and the Spec image of its canonical cocone a limit cone.

Lift the Spec diagram to Over(Spec K), using the structure maps. Pull it back along S to Spec K. Pullback is a right adjoint, so preserves this limit; the forgetful functor preserves connected limits. Extend the resulting cone by pullback symmetry to get apex S_L. The structure maps are smooth and affine and the transition maps are affine by base change. The pullback square for g_L follows from cancellation of the two outer pullback squares.

For a stalk element in any cohomological degree, hE gives n>0 with n*x=0 and n nonzero in K. Hence n is a unit in K, and its image under K to Gamma(S,O_S) is a unit. Apply smoothBaseChange_of_inverseLimit to g and the constructed smooth system. Its canonical exchange is the one in the conclusion; proof irrelevance identifies the commutativity witnesses.

theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_separableFieldExtension
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension K L)
    (T S : Over (Spec (.of K))) (g : T ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact g.left] [QuasiSeparated g.left]
    (E : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf T.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hE : HasTorsionCohomologyOfInvertibleOrder K T E.obj) :
    IsIso ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (⟨by simp [Over.pullback_map_left]⟩ : CommSq
        (pullback.fst T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
        (((Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map g).left)
        g.left (pullback.fst S.hom
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))))).app E)
